documents.source: CIA estimates: Steury 1996, no. 1, vol. pp. 9-37
documents.title: NIE 11-56: Soviet Gross Capabilities for Attack on the US and Key Overseas Installations and Forces Through Mid-1959 (as reproduced in Steury 1996, no. 1)

proposal.quote: We have also estimated that by mid-1959 the USSR would have some 400 BISON and 300 BEAR aircraft in operational use.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The estimate's probable mid-1959 projection, about three years out, is 700 heavy bombers (400 BISON plus 300 BEAR), with no ICBM expected before 1960-1961 and no quantified submarine-launched missile force; 700 falls in the 200-999 band.
